title: Lets Create Some Magic
description: A mod-pack designed around adding features to the game that make it more fun and enjoyable. This is done by combining many of the mods that i enjoy in hopes that you will to.
body:
Lets Create Some Fun is a mod-pack designed to make the game of minecraft as fun as possable by adding various features such as a skill tree, electrical/power system, various forms of weaponry, a origin system with over 100 origins and create mod automation. all credit goes to the mod developers.

This mod-pack can be very unstable with lower ram allocations the recomended is 4 gigabytes.

I've made a discord for the pack if you need help post you help requests on there:

https://discord.gg/WkbMt5Tt
